title: HiFiPix: Bringing High-Fidelity Real-World Super-Resolution Back to Pixel Space
title_zh: HiFiPix：将高保真真实世界超分辨率带回像素空间

paragraphs.en: Diffusion-based real-world image super-resolution suffers from limited reconstruction fidelity due to information loss in VAE-based latent representations. Recently, pixel-space diffusion models offer a promising high - faithfulness alternative by avoiding latent compression, but adapting them to Real-ISR remains challenging due to inherent patch boundary artifacts and degraded generative capability. To address the issues and maximize the potential of pretrained pixel-space diffusion models, we propose HiFiPix , a pixel - space Real - ISR framework capable of ultra high - fidelity reconstruction and fine - grained visual generation effects. To suppress patch boundary artifacts, we penalize unrealistic high-frequency periodic components with a Cross-Scale Wavelet Discriminator (CWSD) for image-level supervision, and Mixup Contrastive Self-Distillation (MixCSD) for intermediate representation regularization. Furthermore, we uncover a heterogeneous generation-fidelity trade-off across low-rank adapters (LoRA) and propose Selective LoRA Pruning (LoRA-SP) to adaptively prune LoRA layers, enhancing generative capability with minimal deterioration of reconstruction fidelity. Extensive experiments demonstrate that HiFiPix consistently outperforms existing state - of - the - art latent - space methods in terms of both restoration accuracy and perceptual quality by a large margin. Code and models will be released.

paragraphs.en: Real - world image super - resolution (Real-ISR) targets the recovery of low - quality (LQ) images suffering from complex unknown degradations, with the goal of reconstructing high - quality (HQ) counterparts that exhibit both high fidelity and satisfying perceptual quality. Initially, GAN - based algorithms Wang et al. (2021) ; Chen et al. (2023) employ a discriminator to match the distribution of reconstructed images with that of real - scenario images. However, lacking powerful generative priors, GAN - based models exhibit limited capability for recovering fine - grained details.

paragraphs.en: Over the past few years, diffusion-based generative models Rombach et al. (2022) ; Labs (2025) have advanced Real-ISR by producing highly photo-realistic details. However, existing Real-ISR methods Dong et al. (2025) ; Fang et al. (2026) typically rely on the Variational Autoencoder (VAE) Esser et al. (2021) to compress LQ inputs into the latent space for efficient denoising. This irreversible compression discards the subtle textures from LQ inputs, often leading to structural inconsistencies, ghosting artifacts, and ultimately compromised restoration fidelity. To mitigate this issue, prior works try to improve input quality Lin et al. (2024) , reduce the VAE compression ratio Yi et al. (2025) , or inject LQ features into denoising networks Yang et al. (2024) . However, these strategies fail to fundamentally address the information loss introduced by latent space compression, yielding reduced generative capability ( e . g ., blurry leaves in the top row of Fig. 1 ) or limited fidelity gains ( e . g ., distorted characters in the bottom row of Fig. 1 ). As a result, restoring highly faithful textures while preserving excellent visual quality still remains a significant challenge in Real-ISR.

paragraphs.en: More recently, pixel - level text-to-image (T2I) diffusion models Yu et al. (2026) ; Cai et al. (2026) have demonstrated effectiveness in mitigating reconstruction accuracy issues by removing the VAE component. However, roughly fine-tuning pixel-space models to Real-ISR via LoRA adapters still faces two key challenges. First, pixel-space models typically adopt patch-based tokenization, while different tokens only interact within pure MLP-based attention blocks. Unlike VAE-based ones Saharia et al. (2022) ; Esser et al. (2024) , whose convolutional decoders naturally preserve spatial continuity, pixel-space decoding does not explicitly enforce information interaction across patch boundaries. This leads to discontinuities between patches and periodic grid artifacts, particularly in texture-rich regions. As shown in Fig. 2 (a), under the same training strategy, pixel-space models suffer from more severe periodic artifacts than latent models Esser et al. (2024) ; Labs (2025) , degrading the structural consistency across neighboring patches. Second, as depicted in Fig. 2 (b), although removing the VAE eliminates latent compression, it discards the compact semantic representations, making high-level semantic modeling more challenging in pure pixel space. Therefore, this weakens the generative prior and biases models toward deterministic reconstruction rather than plausible detail synthesis. Consequently, models tend to overfit reasonable but over-smoothed structures, while losing their ability to generate missing high-frequency details, especially under severe degradations.

paragraphs.en: To address these challenges, we propose HiFiPix , a pixel-space framework for high-fidelity Real-ISR. We first focus on patch-boundary artifacts arising from pixel-space decoding and observe that they mainly manifest as discontinuities in high-frequency structures. This motivates us to exploit coherent high-frequency information for cross-patch continuity. Specifically, we introduce a Cross-Scale Wavelet Discriminator (CSWD) that propagates high-frequency features across scales for boundary-aware image-level supervision, and further propose a Mixup Contrastive Self-Distillation (MixCSD) that leverages an HQ-mixed branch to regularize intermediate representations at feature levels. Together, they provide complementary external and internal supervision to suppress patch-boundary artifacts. Furthermore, we address degradation of generative capability during training. We observe that LoRA updates across layers are not equally necessary: some deep layers merely echo transformations already made by shallower layers, contributing to overfitting pixel-level characteristics rather than preserving high-level semantics. We thus propose Selective LoRA Pruning (LoRA-SP) , which detects and prunes such redundant layers via Centered Kernel Alignment-based representational Kornblith et al. (2019) , protects fidelity-critical layers from pruning, and progressively freezes rest, thereby constraining fine-tuning capacity precisely where overfitting risks occur.
paragraphs.zh: 为应对这些挑战，我们提出 HiFiPix，一个面向高保真 Real-ISR 的像素空间框架。 我们首先关注像素空间解码所产生的图像块边界伪影，并观察到它们主要表现为高频结构的不连续。 这促使我们利用连贯的高频信息来实现跨图像块的连续性。 具体而言，我们引入了一个跨尺度小波判别器（CSWD），它跨尺度传播高频特征以进行边界感知的图像级监督；并进一步提出混合对比自蒸馏（MixCSD），利用一个与高质量图像混合的分支在特征层面正则化中间表示。 二者共同提供互补的外部与内部监督，以抑制图像块边界伪影。 此外，我们还解决了训练过程中生成能力退化的问题。 我们观察到，并非所有跨层的 LoRA 更新都是同等必要的：一些深层只是在重复浅层已经完成的变换，导致对像素级特征的过拟合，而不是保留高层语义。 因此，我们提出选择性 LoRA 剪枝（LoRA-SP），它通过基于中心化核对齐（Centered Kernel Alignment）的表示相似性度量（Kornblith et al. (2019)）检测并剪除此类冗余层，保护对保真度关键的层不被剪枝，并逐步冻结其余层，从而将微调容量精确约束在过拟合风险发生之处。

paragraphs.en: We propose HiFiPix , a Real-ISR method built on a pretrained pixel-level model, shifting Real-ISR from latent-space to pixel-space modeling, achieving high-fidelity restoration without sacrificing generative capability or inference efficiency.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 HiFiPix，一种基于预训练像素级模型的 Real-ISR 方法，将 Real-ISR 从潜在空间建模转向像素空间建模，在不牺牲生成能力或推理效率的情况下实现高保真修复。

paragraphs.en: We propose CSWD that propagates high-frequency features across scales for boundary-aware image-level supervision, and MixCSD , which distills clean representations to enhance patch-level discriminability, jointly mitigating patch-boundary artifacts.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了CSWD，它跨尺度传播高频特征以实现边界感知的图像级监督；同时提出了MixCSD，它通过蒸馏干净表征来增强补丁级判别能力，二者共同缓解补丁边界伪影。

paragraphs.en: We propose LoRA-SP , which identifies functionally redundant LoRA layers via representational drift and progressively prunes them while protecting fidelity-critical layers, preserving the pretrained generative prior during supervised fine-tuning.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出 LoRA-SP，它通过表征漂移识别功能冗余的 LoRA 层，并在保护保真度关键层的同时逐步对其进行剪枝，从而在监督微调过程中保留预训练的生成先验。

paragraphs.en: We introduce Dual-Q-Bench , a high-quality paired Real-ISR benchmark that addresses the low-quality GT and background de-focus in existing benchmarks, enabling more reliable evaluation of both generative capability and reconstruction fidelity.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出 Dual-Q-Bench，一个高质量的成对 Real-ISR 基准，解决了现有基准中低质量 GT 和背景失焦的问题，从而能够更可靠地评估生成能力与重建保真度。

paragraphs.en: With the advent of large-scale T2I models, diffusion-based Real-ISR methods have surpassed GAN-based approaches. Existing methods utilize LQ input to control diffusion models for faithful restoration by leveraging pluggable adapters Chen et al. (2025b) , dual-stream architectures Yang et al. (2024) , ControlNet Yu et al. (2024) , initialized restoration modules Lin et al. (2024) , semantic conditioning Wu et al. (2026) , and large-scale high-quality training datasets Yu et al. (2024) . Furthermore, to fully use input information, methods like OSEDiff Wu et al. (2024b) and TSD-SR Dong et al. (2025) replace random noise with LQ images, while S3Diff Zhang et al. (2024) and ODTSR Fang et al. (2026) incorporate GAN loss to enhance perceptual quality. TVT Yi et al. (2025) increases the VAE latent resolution to improve fidelity, whereas LucidFlux Fei et al. (2026) and StrSR Wang et al. (2026a) improve fidelity by fine-tuning FLUX Labs (2025) or Z-image Cai et al. (2025) with increased VAE channel capacity. Nevertheless, these methods still operate in latent spaces, where VAE compression inevitably limits reconstruction fidelity. In contrast, we perform Real-ISR directly in pre-trained pixel spaces Cai et al. (2026) , enabling high-fidelity and perceptually pleasing Real-ISR.

paragraphs.en: Following classical one-step fine-tuning paradigms Yi et al. (2025) , we identify two critical insights when applying HiDream-O1-Image for Real-ISR. First , patch-boundary artifacts may not arise solely from the patch-wise architecture of pixel-space models. As shown in Fig. 3 (a), grid-like artifacts become more pronounced under severe degradation than under mild degradation, suggesting that imperfect high-frequency reconstruction is an important cause of boundary artifacts, as severe degradation makes high-frequency reconstruction more challenging. This observation motivates a low-cost and architecture-agnostic strategy to explicitly regularize high-frequency components. Specifically, we design the Cross-Scale Wavelet Discriminator, which penalizes spurious boundary artifacts via multi-scale information constraints. Besides, we propose Mixup Contrastive Self-Distillation to ensure faithful generation of genuine high-frequency details.

paragraphs.en: We conduct a user study to evaluate the quality of Dual-Q-Bench against existing Real-ISR benchmarks, including RealSR Cai et al. (2019) , DRealSR Wei et al. (2020) , GGT Kong et al. (2026) , and ScreenSR Wu et al. (2026) . We randomly sample 50 50 GT-LQ image pairs from each dataset for evaluation. In each trial, 17 17 participants are presented with five image pairs from different datasets and asked to select the best one based on GT quality (clarity, background de-focus, and realism), LQ authenticity, and GT–LQ alignment (color, brightness, and position). As shown in Tab. 7 , Dual-Q-Bench achieves the highest user preference rate of 76 % 76\% , substantially surpassing the second-best, GGT ( 10.7 % 10.7\% ), confirming the best quality.
paragraphs.zh: 我们进行了一项用户研究，将 Dual-Q-Bench 与现有 Real-ISR 基准（包括 RealSR Cai et al. (2019)、DRealSR Wei et al. (2020)、GGT Kong et al. (2026) 和 ScreenSR Wu et al. (2026)）进行对比，以评估其质量。 我们从每个数据集中随机采样 50 对 GT-LQ 图像用于评估。 在每次试验中，17 名参与者会看到来自不同数据集的五个图像对，并要求他们基于 GT 质量（清晰度、背景虚化和真实感）、LQ 真实性以及 GT–LQ 对齐（颜色、亮度和位置）选出最佳的一对。 如 Tab. 7 所示，Dual-Q-Bench 达到了最高的用户偏好率 76%，大幅超越排名第二的 GGT（10.7%），证实了其最佳质量。

paragraphs.en: Datasets and Evaluation Protocols. We use LSDIR Li et al. (2023) and the first 10,000 10,000 images from FFHQ Kornblith et al. (2019) as the training sets. (2025a) to assess the consistency between full-reference and no-reference evaluation even the reference image is imperfect.

paragraphs.en: LoRA - SP. LoRA - SP identifies redundant LoRA layers for pruning and incorporates a fidelity - aware veto mechanism, which retains critical layers by postponing their pruning to later candidates. As shown in Tab. 7 , redundancy detection alone boosts generation quality yet causes notable fidelity drops. Equipped with the fidelity - aware veto, LoRA - SP yields an improved generation - fidelity trade - off and consistently surpasses uniform and random LoRA pruning. These results validate our design and suggest an interpretable path to enhance pixel - space model generation via selective LoRA pruning. Moreover, Tab. 7 indicates that this strategy yields marginal gains for latent - space models ( e . g ., Z-Image), probably because VAE - driven semantic compression produces little layer redundancy. Hence, LoRA - SP is tailored for boosting the generation performance of pixel - space models.
paragraphs.zh: LoRA - SP。 LoRA - SP 识别可剪枝的冗余 LoRA 层，并引入保真度感知的否决机制，通过将关键层的剪枝推迟到后续候选对象来保留这些关键层。 如表 7 所示，仅进行冗余检测即可提升生成质量，却会导致显著的保真度下降。 配备保真度感知否决机制后，LoRA - SP 带来了更优的生成 - 保真度权衡，并持续超越均匀剪枝和随机 LoRA 剪枝。 这些结果验证了我们的设计，并表明了一条通过选择性 LoRA 剪枝来增强像素空间模型生成的可解释路径。 此外，表 7 表明该策略对潜在空间模型（例如 Z-Image）的增益有限，这可能是由于 VAE 驱动的语义压缩几乎不产生层冗余。 因此，LoRA - SP 专为提升像素空间模型的生成性能而设计。

paragraphs.en: HiFiPix suffers from two main limitations. First, while patch - boundary artifacts are mostly mitigated, several extremely blurred inputs still contain faint residual seams within texture - rich areas. Adding a generative decoder ( e . g ., PiD Lu et al. (2026a) ) could suppress these artifacts further, yet we abandon it for the additional consumption. Second, as our pipeline does not rely on text prompts, we exclude text - conditioned metrics such as CLIPIQA. These metrics focus mainly on text - image alignment, thereby our prompt - free setting yields inherently low scores that offer limited evaluation results.

paragraphs.en: We present HiFiPix, a pixel - space generative framework which enables faithful restoration by removing VAE compression. To mitigate patch - boundary artifacts and generative degradation, we propose CSWD, MixCSD for enhanced high - frequency reconstruction and cross - patch consistency, and LoRA - SP to generate fine-grained details with minimal fidelity sacrifice. We further construct Dual - Q - Bench, a high - quality benchmark for reliable evaluation. Experiments show HiFiPix outperforms VAE - based methods, demonstrating the promise of pixel - space modeling for Real - ISR.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出 HiFiPix，一个像素空间生成框架，通过移除 VAE 压缩实现忠实还原。 为了缓解图块边界伪影和生成退化，我们提出 CSWD、MixCSD（用于增强高频重建和跨图块一致性）以及 LoRA-SP（以最小的保真度牺牲生成细粒度细节）。 我们进一步构建了 Dual-Q-Bench，一个用于可靠评估的高质量基准。 实验表明 HiFiPix 优于基于 VAE 的方法，展示了像素空间建模在 Real-ISR 中的前景。

sents.en: We present HiFiPix, a pixel - space generative framework which enables faithful restoration by removing VAE compression.
sents.zh: 我们提出 HiFiPix，一个像素空间生成框架，通过移除 VAE 压缩实现忠实还原。

sents.en: To mitigate patch - boundary artifacts and generative degradation, we propose CSWD, MixCSD for enhanced high - frequency reconstruction and cross - patch consistency, and LoRA - SP to generate fine-grained details with minimal fidelity sacrifice.

paragraphs.en: Existing paired Real-ISR benchmarks often suffer from low-quality or unrealistic GT, which can compromise the reliability of fidelity and generation evaluation. As shown in Fig. 7 , existing benchmarks ( e . g ., RealSR Cai et al. (2019) and DrealSR Wei et al. (2020) ) contain GT with blur details or background de-focus. Such imperfections introduce an undesirable evaluation bias: outputs with richer and more realistic details may deviate from deficient GT and receive lower fidelity scores, while outputs that closely mimic the imperfect GT may be favored instead, finally leading to unreasonable measurements, which is also indicated in Chen et al. (2025a) . Besides, background de-focus in DIV2K Agustsson and Timofte (2017) and ScreenSR Wu et al. (2026) complicates fidelity assessment, as recovering sharp structures in the background can be incorrectly penalized as deviation from the GT. Furthermore, large-model-generated GT ( e . g ., GGT-GeneralMix Kong et al. (2026) ) do not necessarily guarantee faithful details due to potential hallucinations. To address these limitations, we construct Dual-Q-Bench , a high-quality real-world paired benchmark with realistic and sharp GT images at 1024 2 1024^{2} resolution, enabling more reliable evaluation of both fidelity and generation quality.
paragraphs.zh: 现有的配对真实图像超分辨率基准往往受制于低质量或不真实的真值图像，这可能损害保真度与生成质量评估的可靠性。 如图 7 所示，现有基准（例如 RealSR Cai 等人 （2019）与 DrealSR Wei 等人 （2020））包含带有模糊细节或背景失焦的真值图像。 这些缺陷引入了不理想的评估偏差：细节更丰富、更真实的输出可能偏离有缺陷的真值图像而获得较低的保真度分数，而那些紧贴不完美真值图像的输出反而可能受到青睐，最终导致不合理的测量结果，Chen 等人（2025a）也指出了这一点。 此外，DIV2K Agustsson 与 Timofte（2017）以及 ScreenSR Wu 等人 （2026）中的背景失焦使保真度评估变得复杂，因为恢复背景中的清晰结构可能被错误地判定为偏离真值图像而受到惩罚。 而且，由大模型生成的真值图像（例如 GGT-GeneralMix Kong 等人 （2026））由于潜在的幻觉问题，并不一定能保证细节的忠实性。 为解决这些局限，我们构建了 Dual-Q-Bench，这是一个高质量的 real-world 配对基准，其真值图像真实且清晰，分辨率为 1024 2 1024^{2}，能够对保真度与生成质量进行更可靠的评估。

paragraphs.en: GT Construction: We crawl high-resolution photographs from Unsplash and filter them using a combination of NR metrics ( e . g ., MANIQA Yang et al. (2022) , MUSIQ Ke et al. paragraphs.en: We compare generative backbone, language model, and trainable component parameters across existing Real-ISR methods in Tab. 10 . Our generative backbone is substantially more compact than methods built on large generative architectures: ODTSR and LucidFlux use 22B Qwen and 12B FLUX-dev backbones, respectively, incurring heavy parameter overhead. Furthermore, removing the text encoder cuts our total parameters relative to SDXL-, SD3-, SD3.5-, and Z-Image-based approaches such as SUPIR, FaithDiff, DiT4SR, and StrSR. Our method requires merely 207.1M trainable parameters, surpassing all multi-step methods and delivering better parameter efficiency than single-step methods relying on large-scale generative backbones (e.g., ODTSR and StrSR). While SD2.1-based single-step methods have fewer trainable parameters, they yield poorer restoration performance. Together with our competitive restoration quality, these results verify our method’s superior efficiency in both model size and fine-tuning cost.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在表10中比较了现有Real-ISR方法的生成式骨干、语言模型以及可训练组件参数。 我们的生成式骨干比基于大型生成架构的方法要紧凑得多：ODTSR和LucidFlux分别使用22B的Qwen和12B的FLUX-dev骨干，带来了沉重的参数开销。 此外，移除文本编码器使我们的总参数量低于基于SDXL、SD3、SD3.5和Z-Image的方法，如SUPIR、FaithDiff、DiT4SR和StrSR。 我们的方法仅需207.1M可训练参数，超越了所有多步方法，并比依赖大规模生成式骨干的单步方法（如ODTSR和StrSR）具有更好的参数效率。 虽然基于SD2.1的单步方法可训练参数更少，但它们的修复性能较差。 结合我们有竞争力的修复质量，这些结果验证了我们的方法在模型规模和微调成本两方面的卓越效率。

paragraphs.en: Number of Selected Layers in LoRA-SP. With 35 35 LoRA layers total for fine-tuning, Tab. 12 examines how many layers should be pruned to boost generative capability while preserving fidelity. We find that both insufficient and excessive pruning yield suboptimal results. Specifically, pruning too few layers has only a limited effect on improving generative performance. While pruning more layers can improve generative performance, it severely compromises the model’s fidelity. Pruning 4 4 layers of all LoRA layers achieves the optimal trade-off between fidelity and generative capability.

paragraphs.en: Number of Distillation Layers in MixCSD. Tab. 12 analyzes the effect of intermediate layer quantity for MixCSD-based contrastive distillation. We find that insufficient distillation layers provide limited supervision, hindering the generation of high-frequency representations and thus impeding performance improvements. Conversely, distilling excessive layers imposes redundant constraints on intermediate features and reduces generative flexibility. Accordingly, we uniformly adopt 5 5 layers (roughly 1 / 7 1/7 of total layers) for contrastive distillation in final settings.

paragraphs.en: Layer-Selective Freezing vs. Layer-Adaptive Attenuation. We initially expected that layer-adaptive attenuation of LoRA across all layers would improve generative quality, as weakening the adapters should release the generative prior of the pretrained backbone. However, no gain was observed in practice: such attenuation only rescales the magnitude of each layer’s update while preserving its direction, so the adaptation drift is weakened but never removed, and every layer is left in an intermediate state that matches neither the pretrained backbone nor the converged adapter. We therefore adopt a more decisive layer-selective freezing of LoRA instead.
